rv.q: I highly recommend seeing The Swallow.
Their heartfelt performances serve as a powerful reminder that grief is myriad, and that in the end, it is the human connection through empathy that saves us all.
Specific details like that, ultimately, make this evening incredibly worthwhile.
McKenzie-Voigt plays a mother so many of us have known and loved, struggled with, and empathized with.
The show's core conversation is hugely resonant, and I was grateful to watch it play out the way it did.

cn.t: This intimate two-hander about a voice lesson that reveals hidden connections earns praise for its bone-cutting dialogue and emotional depth, though its central twist proves somewhat predictable.
